words.gloss: and to those who have renounced
and to those who have passed away
he who lives in a home (the householder)

literal: To those who have renounced, and to the destitute, and to those who have passed away, he who is called a householder is a support.
translation: The householder is the support for those who have renounced the world, the destitute who cannot support themselves, and the departed who have passed away.
modern: துறவிகளுக்கும், வறுமையில் உள்ளவர்களுக்கும், இறந்தவர்களுக்கும் இல்லறத்தில் வாழ்பவனே துணையாவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the social and moral duties of a householder by identifying three groups that depend on him. 'துறந்தார்' refers to ascetics who have renounced material life and rely on others for food. 'துவ்வாதவர்' refers to the poor and helpless who cannot secure their own livelihood. 'இறந்தார்' refers to ancestors or deceased relatives whose memory and rites are preserved by the living. By sustaining these three groups, the householder serves as their essential support (துணை).
